about-text-p1: Hello, world! This is Jonathan Rodríguez, Full Stack developer. With more than {{yearsOfExperience}} years of experience as web developer, I have worked in fields ranging from digital marketing to automation in telecommunications processes, through employee management and Human Resources.
about-text-p2: In my free time I have designed and developed community management projects, market analyzer, data backup for dental clinic and even a role-playing game.
about-text-p3: If you want to know a little more about my skills and knowledge, I invite you to continue scrolling. Don't hesitate to get in touch if you have any questions!

services-heading: What I can do for your project.
services-intro: I work as an independent developer and technical consultant. I get involved in the problem, not just the code.
service-apis-desc: Design and implementation of robust REST APIs. Hexagonal architecture, DDD and production-ready microservices.
service-fullstack-desc: Complete web apps end-to-end: from database to UI. Built with React, Next.js and TypeScript.
service-consulting-desc: Architecture review, code audit and strategic advice. I help teams make better technical decisions.
service-automation-desc: Scripts, pipelines and integrations that eliminate repetitive work. Real experience in critical production environments.

service-maintenance-desc: I take over existing projects: refactoring, migrations, new features and technical debt.

exp-plexus-desc: Development and maintenance of microservices in the telecoms sector. Hexagonal architecture, async messaging with Kafka and deployment on Openshift. Unit testing and identity system integrations.
exp-bitbox-desc: Full stack web application development for IKEA's technology infrastructure in the Islands. Java microservices and React front-end.
exp-coco-desc: Web development with JavaScript in a startup environment.
exp-desacan-desc: Web development internship. First contact with a professional environment.
proj-alfred-short: Automated building manager with hexagonal architecture. REST API built with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL database and containerised deployment with Docker.
proj-alfred-problem: Manual building management involves many repetitive tasks: access control, notifications, incident logging. Alfred automates these flows with a centralised API.
proj-alfred-d1: Hexagonal architecture to keep the domain decoupled from infrastructure.
proj-alfred-d2: Spring Boot 3.4 with Java 21 to leverage Virtual Threads and better performance.
proj-alfred-d3: PostgreSQL 17 with relational modelling optimised for real-time state queries.
proj-alfred-d4: Docker + Compose for a reproducible dev environment and simplified deployment.
proj-oniria-short: Role-playing game backend with FastAPI. Player and character system, inventory and combat mechanics with persistent state in PostgreSQL.
proj-oniria-problem: Oniria is the backend of a multiplayer role-playing game. The main challenge was modelling a complex domain (characters, inventories, combat) with persistent, session-consistent state.
proj-oniria-d1: FastAPI for development speed and automatic validation with Pydantic.
proj-oniria-d2: Relational data model in PostgreSQL for persistent game state.
proj-oniria-d3: Inventory system with typed slots and equipment rules.
proj-oniria-d4: Turn-based combat mechanics with modifier and status logic.
proj-oniria-d5: Docker for containerisation and easy local startup.
proj-portfolio-short: This very portfolio. Built with Next.js 15, React 19 and Tailwind CSS. ES/EN multilingual support, optimised with App Router and automatic deployment.
proj-portfolio-problem: Personal portfolio built with the front-end technologies I use day to day. It serves both as a professional presentation and a practical demonstration of the stack.
proj-portfolio-d1: Next.js 15 with App Router and Server Components for maximum performance.
proj-portfolio-d2: ES/EN multilingual support without external i18n dependencies.
proj-portfolio-d3: Tailwind CSS with mobile-first design and responsive typography.
proj-portfolio-d5: Automatic deployment on every push to main.
